description: This file contains the implementation of the NodeId class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It manages network node identifiers, including IP addresses (IPv4 and IPv6), Unix domain sockets, netlink sockets, and Bluetooth sockets. The file includes constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and methods for resolving hostnames, checking multicast/local interfaces, and generating qualified names.

classes.name: NodeId
classes.description: Represents a network node identifier, supporting IPv4, IPv6, Unix domain sockets, netlink, and Bluetooth addresses. Provides methods for comparison, resolution, and information retrieval.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two NodeId objects for equality based on their socket family and address details.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns a sockaddr_in, sockaddr_in6, sockaddr_un, sockaddr_nl, sockaddr_ll, sockaddr_hci, or sockaddr_l2 to the NodeId object.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Resolves a hostname or address string into the internal socket address structure, supporting IPv4, IPv6, and other address types.

methods.name: HostName
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname associated with the NodeId, performing DNS lookup if necessary.

methods.name: HostAddress
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the NodeId's IP address.

methods.name: AnyInterface
methods.description: Returns a NodeId representing any network interface (all zeros).

methods.name: IsAnyInterface
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId represents any interface (all zeros).

methods.name: IsLocalInterface
methods.description: Checks if the NodeId represents a local loopback interface.

methods.name: Origin
methods.description: Returns a NodeId representing the origin of the current NodeId.

methods.name: DefaultMask
methods.description: Returns the default network mask based on the address type.

methods.name: Broadcast
methods.description: Calculates the broadcast address based on the current address and mask.

methods.name: IsMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the address is a multicast address.
